Class Hdf5File

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.hdf5.Hdf5File
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class Hdf5File extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Thin wrapper around an HDF5 file handle. Implements AutoCloseable for try-with-resources support.

Thread-safety model: each Hdf5File owns a ReentrantReadWriteLock that serialises access from derived Hdf5Group and Hdf5Dataset instances. Readers do not block readers; writers are exclusive. When the native HDF5 library is not thread-safe, readers are promoted to the write (exclusive) lock.

      public boolean isThreadSafe()

    • lockForReading

      public void lockForReading()
      Acquire the read lock for the duration of an HDF5 read call. Promoted to the write (exclusive) lock when the linked libhdf5 is not thread-safe. Must be paired with unlockForReading().
